# Temple Scroll Column 42 — The EMET Bible (Literal)
**Translator:** EMET | **Source:** 11QT (Cave 11), Col. 42 | **Condition:** well preserved

---

**42:1** And a clean person shall sprinkle upon the unclean on the third day and on the seventh day, and he shall purify him on the seventh day.

**42:2** And the one who sprinkles the water of purification shall wash his garments; and whoever touches the water of purification shall be unclean until evening.

**42:3** And whatever the unclean person touches shall be unclean; and the person who touches it shall be unclean until evening.

**42:4** And in every house into which the unclean person enters — everything in the house shall be unclean for seven days.

**42:5** And every open vessel that has no covering fastened upon it shall be unclean.

**42:6** And he shall purify him on the seventh day; and he shall wash his garments and bathe in water and be clean at evening.

**42:7** And any person who touches the surface of a human bone or one slain or one who died or a grave in the open field — he shall be unclean for seven days.

**42:8** And they shall do for him according to the whole statute of purification; and he shall sprinkle upon him on the third day and on the seventh day.

**42:9** And on the seventh day he shall be clean; and he shall wash his garments and bathe in water, and at sunset he shall be clean.

**42:10** And anyone who is unclean in the open field and does not purify himself — his uncleanness is still upon him, and whoever touches him shall be unclean.

**42:11** And anyone who touches the one who is unclean shall be unclean until evening; and he who sprinkles the purification water shall wash his garments.

**42:12** And whoever touches the water of purification shall be unclean until evening; and anything that the unclean person touches shall be unclean.

**42:13** And the person who touches it shall wash his garments and bathe in water and be unclean until evening.

**42:14** And the sons of Israel shall keep all these statutes, and they shall not defile their camps in the midst of which I dwell.

**42:15** For I the LORD dwell in the midst of the sons of Israel; and you shall sanctify your camps and make them holy.

**42:16** You shall not make your camps detestable with any unclean thing, for I am the LORD who dwells in your midst.

---

*EMET notes: Column 42 continues the purification procedures from Column 41, specifying the contagion chain of corpse impurity. The regulations closely parallel Numbers 19:17-22. The column concludes with a theological motivation: God's indwelling among Israel demands camp purity (vv. 14-16), echoing Numbers 5:3 and Deuteronomy 23:14.*
